title: bunker-shielding-mc: Geant4 Monte Carlo models for radiotherapy bunker shielding benchmarked against NCRP 151
description: Geant4 models of a 6 MV broad beam through ordinary concrete (benchmark against NCRP 151 tenth-value layers: TVL1 36.8 cm vs 37 cm, TVLe 33.8 cm vs 33 cm) and of a 6 MV bunker maze door with lead door and water phantom (scatter and leakage components compared with the NCRP 151 maze method). Includes source code, macros, analysis scripts and result files.
